proposals.expected_signal: Higher NDCG@10 from stronger tail-item retrieval without hurting head-item ranking, with gains concentrated on users whose positives connect through sparse neighborhoods.
proposals.failure_mode: Residual mixing may over-amplify noisy low-degree links, causing unstable item scores and worse ranking for dense-profile users.
proposals.hypothesis: In LightGCN, reweight each propagation layer by normalized inverse-degree statistics and keep a stronger layer-0 residual so sparse nodes receive more useful multi-hop signal without fully washing out ID-specific preference.

proposals.expected_signal: Improved top-10 precision from cleaner separation between near-miss negatives and true positives, especially when many items are embedding-near due to popularity effects.
proposals.failure_mode: Margin geometry can over-constrain embedding norms or collapse score spread, reducing personalization and hurting convergence speed.
proposals.hypothesis: Replace plain dot-product BPR behavior with cosine-style normalized user/item embeddings plus a small positive angular margin on observed pairs, forcing ranking updates to act on direction rather than norm inflation.

proposals.expected_signal: Better NDCG@10 if auxiliary invariance reduces oversensitivity to individual edges and improves robustness of user/item embeddings under sparse supervision.
proposals.failure_mode: The auxiliary contrastive term may dominate ranking loss, producing uniform embeddings that look stable but rank poorly.
proposals.hypothesis: Train a message-transform graph encoder with the main ranking loss plus a light contrastive objective between two stochastic edge-drop views, encouraging representations that preserve preference signal while ignoring brittle graph perturbations.

proposals.expected_signal: Top-rank improvement from reducing harmful updates on ambiguous negatives while preserving learning on clearly separated pairs.
proposals.failure_mode: If confidence weights mostly track popularity, the model may under-train on informative hard cases and regress toward popularity ranking.
proposals.hypothesis: Keep the LightGCN encoder fixed in form but weight each pairwise loss term by a confidence function derived from current score gap and node-frequency context, so optimization focuses on ranking mistakes with clearer training value.
